name: Kaizen Realty
subtitle: Real Estate & Property Marketing
challenge: Acquire qualified luxury real estate buyers and schedule on-site property walkthrough visits in a highly crowded urban real estate market with high lead acquisition costs.
approach: Designed multi-tier Google Demand Gen campaigns combining cinematic lifestyle renderings with floor plan transparency.
Targeted high-net-worth demographic clusters with custom affinity audiences and in-market property search intent.
Integrated a two-step lead verification form capturing verified budget ranges and expected move-in timelines.
Configured instant WhatsApp and CRM alerts enabling property advisors to contact hot inquiries within 5 minutes of submission.
result: Generated 84 verified property buyer consultations, reduced Cost Per Qualified Lead by 45.7% (to ₹624), and tripled site visit attendance from 12% to 36%.

strategies.title: 01 GOOGLE DEMAND GEN CAMPAIGNS
strategies.description: Deployed YouTube Shorts and Discover feed ads pairing architectural video walkthroughs with localized geo-fencing.

strategies.title: 02 CAROUSEL AMENITY TESTING
strategies.description: Tested carousel creative formats showcasing clubhouses, private balconies, and smart home automation vs. generic building exterior renderings.

strategies.title: 03 BUDGET-QUALIFIED LEAD FORMS
strategies.description: Filtered out casual inquiries with mandatory budget brackets, lifting site-visit show-up rate to 36%.

snapshots.campaignName: Kaizen Realty Buyer Acquisition & Site Visit Campaign
snapshots.caption: High-aesthetic property creative featuring interior layout and verified consultation bookings.
snapshots.note: Generated 84 verified consultations with 36% site visit show-up rate.

timeline.title: AUDIENCE DISCOVERY
timeline.description: Geo-fencing affluent residential pin codes and custom intent audiences looking at residential real estate.

timeline.title: CREATIVE PRODUCTION
timeline.description: Creating lifestyle carousel sets and short video previews of sample residences.

timeline.title: TWO-STEP QUALIFICATION
timeline.description: Implementing pre-qualification fields and instantaneous WhatsApp CRM confirmation for scheduled visits.

keyLearnings: Lifestyle carousels highlighting smart home features achieved 38% higher engagement than standard elevation photos.
Pre-qualifying budget on the lead form reduced unqualified inquiries by 26% while increasing sales closure rate by 2.2x.
Instant sub-5 minute consultation confirmation via WhatsApp was the primary driver of the 36% site visit show-up rate.

provenance.source: Meta Ads + Google Ads Verified Audit
